buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %.

2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses i) Bidder shall submit point wise confirmation of specification as well as special conditions along with the of fer. ii ) Prices on gem are inclusive of all cost component i.e. GST, freight, P&F, insurance etc. Any other conditi on mentioned anywhere in the attachment shall be ignored. iii) Vendor should submit bid only if tender additional terms & conditions and GEM general terms & conditi ons are acceptable Any commercial term mentioned as an attachment shall be ignored. iv) NALCO is a SA8000 certified company and all bidders interested to supply material to NALCO should be committed to social accountability. Hence, please submit the completely filled SA8000 questionnaire provi ded with the tender (without any alteration to the format) along with the offer. SA8000 certified companies can submit their certification. Non-compliance to the requirements of SA8000 may lead to rejection of the offer. v) TDS under section 194Q: a) Finance Act 2021 has brought amendments in existing TDS/TCS Sections and has introduced new Secti ons 194Q (Deduction of tax at Source on payment of certain sum for purchase of goods ) and 206AB (S pecial provision for deduction of tax at source for non-filers of income-tax return) among others. The a bove Sections would be effective from 01st July, 2021. b) NALCO, being Buyer (under Section 194Q inserted in the Income Tax Act, 1961 vide Finance Act 2021) having total sales, gross receipts, or turnover from business above Rupees Ten Crores during the last F inancial Year, will deduct TDS under Section 194Q, w.e.f. 01.07.2021, at the prescribed rate of 0.1% on the purchase value of any goods, aggregate of which is exceeding the threshold limit of Rs.50 Lakhs in a Financial year. c) Accordingly, Vendors/Sellers are not to to collect tax at source under section 206C(1H) of the Act w.e.f. 01.07.2021, in case provisions of section are applicable to them. d) The above is as per the current statute and is subject to modification(s) based on amendments/ notific ations under Income Tax Act, 1961, from time to time. Income Tax TDS, as applicable at the prevailin g rate on the gross amount billed shall be deducted from the contractor's bills.

e) Vendor/Party categorised/designated as "specified person" under Section 206AB of Income Tax Act, 19 61 shall be liable for TDS at higher rate as provided under the said section, by NALCO. So, Vendors/Co ntractors are advised to submit self-certified copies of Income Tax return (ITR) for each of the Two Prev ious Years for which due date for filing of ITR has expired, along with the Invoice/Bill so as to facilitate NALCO, verify the applicability of Section 206AB. vi) Payment term: 100% Payment will be released on successful installation of the equipment at our site i. e. at NALCO Hospital, M&R Complex, Damanjodi. (Payment of GST subject to the reflection of invoice in GSTR-2A/annexure -2 of NALCO) vii) In case of order placement, vendor shall comply to “EHS (Environment Health & Safety) GUIDELIN ES TO SUPPLIERS” provided with the tender. Viii) No communication shall be entertained out side GeM regarding the subject tender. Representation, if any, for clarification against this tender may be raised on GeM only. iX) Bidder must submit the attached declaration for ‘Implementation of integrity’ for consideration of their offer for evaluation. X) Bank Mandate form is attached in buyer added document. Bidder(s) ‘not registered’ with NALCO needs t o submit the ‘Bank Mandate’ form along with the offer. XI) LD/PRS: Delivery period is the essence of the contract and the materials should be delivered within the delivery period , failing which, NALCO without prejudice to its rights under the contract shall have the opti on either to reduce the price @1/2% of order value per week or part thereof subject to a maximum of 5% o f the undelivered portion/the order value (if the item(s) cannot be used unless full supply is made) or to ca ncel the Order and purchase the materials from alternative source at the risk and cost of the supplier xii) Detailed technical specification as below. PRODUCT NAME:-SHORTWAVE DIATHERMY(TRANSCUTANEOUS ELECT NERVE STIMULATOR) PURPOSE:-TO ALLEVIATE MUSCULOSKELETAL PAIN AND INDUCE DEEP HEATING IN TISSUES FOR THERAPEU TIC PURPOSES. KEY TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS:- * DIATHERMY APPLICATOR TYPE:-INDUCTION FIELD * DISPLAY MONITOR TYPE:-LCD * SPECIAL INDUCTIVE ELECTRODES SHOULD BE INCLUDED WITH MACHINE. * SHOULD HAVE FLEXIBLE PADS(METAL ELECTRODES ENCASED IN RUBBER AND PRODUCE AN ELECTROST ATIC FIELD) * SHOULD HAVE SPACE PLATES(CONSISTS OF RIGID METAL ELECTRODES ENCASED IN A PERPLEX COVER OF ELECTROSTATIC FIELD) * SHOULD HAVE MONO MODE(THE FLAT RIGID COIL ENCASED IN PLASTIC COVER GENERATES ELECTROMA GNETIC FIELDS) * MUST HAVE THE DIPLODE OR DRUM ELECTRODE CONSISTS OF A FLAT COIL ELECTRODE ENCASED IN A P ERPLEX COVER WITH 02 WINGS GENERATES ELECTROMAGNETIC FIELD.

* THE MACHINE MUST BE MOUNTED ON CASTORS WITH STOPPERS. * ADJUSTABLE OUTPUT POWER SETTINGS:-5 to 10 Steps. * PULSE REPETITION FREQUENCY IN INCREMENTS OF 10Hz:-250 to 500 Hrtz OR MORE. * PULSE WIDTH IN INCREMENTS OF 20 MICRO SECONDS:-400 MICROSECONDS. * WARRANTY:-01 YEAR FOLLOWING STANDARD ACCESORIES MUST BE PROVIDED WITH THE MACHINE:- * SPACE PLATES OR MINIMUM DISC ELECTRODES---------------02 NOS * RUBBER ELECTRODE SET----------------------------------02 NOS * MONOPOLAR INDUCTIVE ELCTRODES-------------------------02 NOS * DIPLODE OR DRUM ELECTRODES----------------------------02 NOS * FLAT COIL ELECTRODES----------------------------------02 NOS * HIGH FREQUENCY CABLES---------------------------------02 NOS * FLEXIBLE CABLES TO CONNECT RUBBER ELECTRODES----------02 NOS * FELT SPACERS------------------------------------------02 NOS XIISPECIAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS:- 1. Warranty Period: - Warranty period should be at least one year from the date of Installation. During war ranty period, party should visit at consignee’s site at least twice in a year (i.e.2 preventive maintenance p er year) free of cost for PMS of equipment commencing from the date of installation. PMS sticker has to be pasted on the equipment, indicating PMS done date and next PMS due date. 2. Supplier has to provide annual calibration of medical equipment under warranty and calibration certifica te should be provided in standard format indicating calibration done date and next calibration due date. 3. All software updates (if any required) should be provided free of cost during warranty period. 4. Onsite hands on training and demonstration shall be provided to the user department/technical staff du ring installation and as and when required by user department free of cost. GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS:- 1. Bid specific OEM authorization certificate to be provided by the party. 2. Party should submit OEM WARRANTY certificate along with their despatch documents. 3. The Supplier/OEM shall ensure continued supply of the spare parts/accessories/consumables for supplie d equipment by them to the purchaser during warranty/CMC period. 4. The supplier has to ensure the electrical safety standards as per BIS or standards of electrical safety IEC 60601 or equivalent. 5. It should provide technical maintenance manual detailing Complete maintaining schedule with routine maintenance free Installation by the party at hospital site. 6. Data sheet of the product to be provided along with their Offer. 7. Party should provide their service centre details along with their offer. 8. Party/Seller shall be responsible to carry out installation & commissioning, supervision and demonstratio n of goods equipment. They shall provide required jigs and tools for assembly, minor civil works for the co mpletion of the installation (if any) and training of consignee’s representatives for operating and maintaini ng the equipment and supplying required number of operation and maintenance manual for the goods. In case the category parameters are specifying any requirements regarding the installations, training and ma nuals the same shall also be applicable.
